{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
duplicate_patients = df[df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)]

# Count how many unique patients there are
n_unique_patients = df['patient_id'].nunique()

# Check how many rows there are
n_rows = len(df)

# Check if the duplicate rows are only due to sample_seq (i.e., re-tests)
duplicate_rows_by_id = df.groupby('patient_id').size()
retest_patients = duplicate_rows_by_id[duplicate_rows_by_id > 1]

# Report these values
n_unique_patients, n_rows, len(retest_patients), retest_patients.index.tolist()"}
